untertitel: Create legally sound applications, appeals and notifications in line with current SGB and BGB rules.
hinweisText: All letters are based on the legal standards for 2026. The gUG accepts no liability for complex individual cases. Sending by registered mail with acknowledgement of receipt is strongly recommended.
